changelog:
- Open-World UI: Streamlined Fokk AI with minimal unboxed typography, hairline dividers, and compact pill badges, eliminating bulky nested cards.
- Smooth Header Collapse: Top tab bar gracefully collapses on downward scroll and allows content to smoothly expand and fill vertical space without layout dead zones.
- Universal Reporting Framework: Purged sports transfer assumptions, club announcement fallbacks, and wage speculation from credibility evaluation, general prompt templates, and offline synthesis.
- Scraper Junk Purge: Eradicated publisher promotional CTAs, newsletter signups, app download banners, and cookie consent notices from summarizer extraction.
- Source Provenance Rectification: Fixed publisher provenance chains to only activate on aggregators or explicitly cited sources, preventing false multi-hop flows.
- Targeted Real-Time Journalism: Filtered out non-matching Wikipedia entities to prioritize verified live news reporting.
- Clean Ask AI Answers: Removed raw debug headers and source dumps from generated answers, delivering direct synthesized verdicts with verified publisher pills.
